result.instructions: Tools for Appointedd, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What bookings do I have tomorrow, and who are the customers?"; "Find the next free 30-minute slot for a consultation with any resource this week."; "Book Ada Lovelace (ada@example.org) into the first free slot on Monday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Appointedd data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run appointedd_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run appointedd_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run appointedd_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. appointedd_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: appointedd_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest first by default. Filter by time window (after/before), customer, service, resource, category, status or creation/update time. Each booking has its service, resource, start/end, status and the customers on it (with their notes, questions and statuses). Page with `next`. GET /bookings.

after.description: Only bookings that start at or after this date-time.

before.description: Only bookings that end at or before this date-time.

statuses.description: Only bookings with one of these statuses.

customers.description: Only bookings for customers with one of these ids.

services.description: Only bookings of services with one of these ids.

resources.description: Only bookings of resources with one of these ids.

categories.description: Only bookings of service categories with one of these ids.

ids.description: Only bookings with one of these ids.

created_after.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

created_before.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

updated_after.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

updated_before.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

order_by.description: Sort direction (the API default is desc).

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the dates and times in the reply, e.g. Europe/London (default UTC).

start.description: Page cursor: pass the previous reply's `next` to get the following page.

end.description: Page cursor: pass the previous reply's `prev` to get the preceding page.

tools.name: appointedd_find_available_intervals
tools.title: Find available times
tools.description: Find the start times at which a service can be booked in the given ranges, with the free resource ids for each (and existing group bookings with room). Step 1 of making a booking: pick a start, then appointedd_create_reservation. Read-only. POST /availability/intervals/search.

start.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

end.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

ranges.description: One or more date-time ranges to search, e.g. [{start, end}].

service_id.description: Service the booking would be for (use appointedd_list_services).

resource_ids.description: Resources (staff, rooms) to check. Default: all resources assigned to the service. Not together with resource_group_ids.

resource_group_ids.description: Resource groups whose resources to check. Not together with resource_ids.

duration.description: Continuous minutes that must be free. Default: the service's default duration.

spaces.description: Spaces needed (excludes group bookings with too few spaces). Default 1.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for range times without an offset and for the reply. Default UTC.

tools.name: appointedd_find_available_dates
tools.title: Find available days
tools.description: Find which days in the given ranges have any availability for a service (a calendar view; use appointedd_find_available_intervals for the times). Read-only. POST /availability/days/search.

start.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

end.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (a date-time without an offset is read in UTC unless a timezone is given).

ranges.description: One or more date-time ranges to search, e.g. [{start, end}].

service_id.description: Service the booking would be for (use appointedd_list_services).

resource_ids.description: Resources (staff, rooms) to check. Default: all resources assigned to the service. Not together with resource_group_ids.

resource_group_ids.description: Resource groups whose resources to check. Not together with resource_ids.

duration.description: Continuous minutes that must be free. Default: the service's default duration.

spaces.description: Spaces needed (excludes group bookings with too few spaces). Default 1.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for range times without an offset and for the reply. Default UTC.

tools.name: appointedd_get_reservation
tools.title: Get reservation
tools.description: One reservation (availability slot) by id: its service, resource, times and expiry. GET /availability/slots/{reservation_id}.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the dates and times in the reply, e.g. Europe/London (default UTC).

tools.name: appointedd_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in the CRM (first and last name required; email, mobile, phone, tags optional). POST /customers.

tags.description: Tags to put on the customer.

tools.name: appointedd_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change a customer's name, email, mobile, phone or tags. Only the fields you pass are sent; `tags` replaces the customer's tag list. PUT /customers/{customer_id}.

tags.description: New tag list (replaces the old one).

tools.name: appointedd_create_reservation
tools.title: Create reservation (hold a time)
tools.description: WRITE: hold a date and time for a booking (step 2). The reservation blocks that slot for `expires_after` minutes (default: the organisation's setting); then call appointedd_create_booking with the returned reservation id. Without resource_id a free resource assigned to the service is picked. POST /availability/slots.

start.description: Start date-time, normally a `start` returned by appointedd_find_available_intervals.

resource_id.description: Resource to book. Default: any free resource of the service.

resource_group_ids.description: Restrict the automatic resource choice to these groups.

duration.description: Booking length in minutes; pass the same `duration` you searched with. Default: the service's default duration.

ignore_notice_restriction.description: Ignore the notice period; set it if you searched with it.

ignore_service_schedule.description: Ignore the service's schedule; set it if you searched with it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of `start` (when it has no offset) and of the reply. Default UTC.

tools.name: appointedd_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: WRITE: turn an active reservation into a booking (step 3) for one or more customers; Appointedd matches each customer to the CRM by name/email/mobile or creates it. Payment requests are NOT sent unless send_payment_request is true. With an empty customers list an empty booking is created. POST /bookings.

reservation_id.description: Id returned by appointedd_create_reservation (must not have expired).

notes.description: Free-form notes for this customer on the booking.

marketing_subscribed.description: Customer agreed to marketing emails (default false).

customers.description: Customers to add; [] for an empty booking.

label.description: Label shown on the booking in the appointment screen.

send_payment_request.description: Send each customer a payment request (default false here; the API's own default is true).

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the dates and times in the reply, e.g. Europe/London (default UTC).

tools.name: appointedd_update_booking
tools.title: Update booking
tools.description: WRITE: change a booking's service, resource, label or total spaces, or move it by giving `parts` with new start/end times. Customers are NOT emailed unless send_notifications is true. PUT /bookings/{booking_id}.

service_id.description: Move the booking to this service.

resource_id.description: Assign the booking to this resource.

parts.description: New time parts of the booking (start/end); an availability check runs when moving.

start.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z.

end.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z.

send_notifications.description: Email each customer that the booking changed (default false here; the API's own default is true).

ignore_service_schedule.description: Allow moving outside the service's schedule.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the dates and times in the reply, e.g. Europe/London (default UTC).

tools.name: appointedd_update_booking_customer
tools.title: Update customer on booking
tools.description: WRITE: set the arrival status (Arrived, Complete, No Show, No Status) and/or notes of one customer on a booking. customer_booking_id is the customer's `customer_booking_id` (or `customer_id`) in the booking's customers list. PUT /bookings/{booking_id}/customers/{customer_booking_id}.

notes.description: Replaces the customer's notes on this booking.

tools.name: appointedd_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: WRITE (cannot be undone): cancel a whole booking. Appointedd may notify the customers according to the organisation's settings. To remove one customer from a group booking use appointedd_cancel_booking_customer. POST /bookings/{booking_id}/cancel.

tools.name: appointedd_cancel_booking_customer
tools.title: Cancel customer on booking
tools.description: WRITE (cannot be undone): cancel one customer's place on a booking (the booking stays for the others). customer_booking_id is the `customer_booking_id` in the booking's customers list. POST /bookings/{booking_id}/customers/{customer_booking_id}/cancel.
